text: A reliable reputation score substitutes for redundant labor: if a high reputation worker completes a task, required duplication can fall from fifteen workers to five or fewer, which is what allows micro task work to scale.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Code Review DAO (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4734750
abstract: If a reliable and high reputation score worker completes the tasks, the duplication may be brought from 15 to 5 or less in the decentralized CRDAO setup. This enables unprecedented scaling of micro task work.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: decentralized platforms with portable, wallet linked reputation scores
